title: Run record: one attempted run of the coding-agent gate experiment
description: Written by experiment/tools/run_pilot.py, one per attempted run (including runs refused by the spend cap or not runnable). Outcomes are separate fields, never a combined score. Missing data is null with a reason, never zero. The semantic label is always null: no independent human labels exist.

evidence_kind.description: 'real' for pilot runs; 'synthetic-test' only in unit tests. Summaries refuse to mix them.

identity.description: What ran, from which inputs, where and when.

sequence.description: Position in the frozen run order (order.json).

position_in_task.description: 1-3: the arm's randomized position within its task.

blind_id.description: Opaque id for blinded adjudication; reveals nothing about the arm.

baseline_commit.description: Git commit of the clean workspace.

baseline_tree_sha256.description: Hash of the prepared workspace's files.

final_tree_sha256.description: Hash of the final snapshot's files.

prompt_sha256.description: Hash of the exact prompt sent.

settings_sha256.description: Hash of the run's --settings file (the arm's hooks).

agent_models_reported.description: modelUsage keys the CLI reported: the models that actually answered.

seed.description: Seeds are not supported by the CLI; recorded as such.

environment.description: CLI, Python, Import Linter and platform versions.

termination.description: How the run is classified. not_started_cap: refused by the spend ledger before starting (censored). not_runnable: could not run as its arm specifies, even if the agent process itself succeeded (see agent_termination).

not_runnable.description: Why the run could not run as its arm specifies (for example, the judge was unavailable in arm C).

agent_started.description: Whether the agent process ran. True for a not-runnable arm C run whose agent ran but whose development judge was unavailable.

agent_termination.description: How the agent process itself ended, independent of the run's classification; null when it never started.

behavior.description: Independent evaluator: frozen acceptance and regression tests on the final snapshot.

structural.description: Independent evaluator's own frozen contract on the final snapshot.

semantic_judge.description: The live judge's output on the final snapshot: a judge output, not a label.

semantic_label.description: Always null: no independent human labels.

tampering_detected.description: Instruction, workspace configuration or out-of-workspace gate files changed, workspace settings added, or (records with a settings check) the external --settings file changed, deleted or unreadable.

settings_file_check.description: Result of comparing the external --settings file with its preparation hash (evaluator/settings_integrity.py). 'not_checked' (or absent) in records written before the check existed, including pilot-2026-11-19.

baseline_tests_modified.description: Baseline test files changed or deleted (reported separately from tampering).

gate_final_state.description: The development gate's last word: no_gate (arm A), passed, unresolved (repair budget exhausted or adapter failure), semantic_inconclusive, interrupted (ended while a repair was requested), missing (the hook never ran).

submission.description: Always a synthetic final submission, not a merge.

repair.description: Feedback-driven repair cycles after the first candidate.

cycles.description: Repair requests made (Stop-hook blocks). A lower bound when censored.

censored.description: True when the loop did not converge to a gate pass.

checker_invocations.description: Sensor runs and judge calls during development, counted separately.

usage.description: Reported usage per category. Missing usage stays null with a reason.

cost_usd.description: CLI total_cost_usd. Decimal US dollars as a string.

cost_basis.description: API-equivalent estimate; notional under a subscription login.

development_judge.description: Judge calls made by arm C's hook (null for arms without a hook). Fields: calls, started_calls, unknown_cost_calls, cost_usd (null while any started call has unknown cost), known_cost_subtotal_usd, unknown_cost_held_usd (the ledger charge kept for unknown-cost calls: each call's reservation unless it recorded ledger_charged_usd), unknown_cost_unrecorded_charge_calls, tokens (sums over calls that reported each category), tokens_missing_calls (per category, started calls that did not report it), models, cost_basis. Records written before 2026-11-19's correction lack unknown_cost_held_usd and tokens_missing_calls.

evaluation_judge.description: Judge calls made by the independent evaluator. Fields: calls, started_calls, unknown_cost_calls, cost_usd (null while any started call has unknown cost), known_cost_subtotal_usd, unknown_cost_held_usd (the ledger charge kept for unknown-cost calls: each call's reservation unless it recorded ledger_charged_usd), unknown_cost_unrecorded_charge_calls, tokens (sums over calls that reported each category), tokens_missing_calls (per category, started calls that did not report it), models, cost_basis. Records written before 2026-11-19's correction lack unknown_cost_held_usd and tokens_missing_calls.

time.description: Monotonic seconds around the agent process plus CLI-reported durations.

ci_queue_s.description: Not applicable at the end-of-turn placement.

interventions.description: Documented human interventions during the run (none permitted in the pilot).

infrastructure_retries.description: Earlier attempts of this cell that failed for infrastructure reasons, with their artifacts, agent ledger entry and judge usage (usage.development_judge, usage.evaluation_judge). Never silently dropped; all of it counts towards total spend.

ledger.description: The agent run's spend-ledger entry: id, reservation, charge, status.

artifacts.description: Paths (relative to the example root) of retained, redacted raw evidence.

settings_integrity.description: The settings-integrity check's full output (schema coding-agent-gates/settings-integrity/v1), or null when it was not run.
